# VSS common failures

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Containers started but app does not work | Stale/corrupt persisted MinIO/Postgres/VDMS/data-prep volumes | If not a first-time setup, run `source setup.sh --clean-data`, then rerun the intended setup mode. |
| `pipeline-manager` unhealthy | Postgres health/ping failed; MinIO or feature dependencies unavailable | Check `postgres-service`, `minio-service`, and the mode-specific dependencies before debugging UI. |
| UI unreachable on `http://<host>:12345/` | `nginx` not started or `APP_HOST_PORT=12345` conflict | Use `triage.sh` port checks; free or override `APP_HOST_PORT`, then redeploy. |
| Setup fails before Compose starts | Model-download image/plugin, proxy/token, disk, model/device support, port, or timeout failure | Inspect `ov_models/model-download-*.log`; verify `MODEL_DOWNLOAD_IMAGE`, proxy/token, model/device/precision, disk space, loopback port `8640`, and `MODEL_DOWNLOAD_JOB_TIMEOUT`. |
| `OVMS` container stopped or crash-looping | Model export/config error, host model permissions, unsupported device, token/context error, or GPU memory exhaustion | Inspect `ovms-service` logs and `ov_models/ovms/config.json`; inspect the matching `ov_models/ovms/openvino_models/...` directory; lower token settings or switch device/model. |
| OVMS model files are incomplete or incompatible | Interrupted model-download job or stale host-backed cache | Stop VSS, remove only the affected model directory with user approval, and rerun setup so model-download recreates it. |
| Final summary stuck in `Ready` or `In Progress` | OVMS stopped, or prompt tokens + `max_completion_tokens` exceed model context | Check `docker ps -a | grep ovms` and logs; lower `PM_SUMMARIZATION_MAX_COMPLETION_TOKENS` from default `4000` or choose a larger-context model. |
| OVMS logs show `CL_OUT_OF_RESOURCES` | VLM and LLM compete for GPU memory, or KV cache/model too large | Split VLM/LLM across CPU/GPU, choose smaller/quantized models, reduce concurrency, or adjust `OVMS_CACHE_SIZE_GB` carefully. |
| OVMS cache usage near `100.0%` | KV cache exhausted under long/concurrent generation | Increase `OVMS_CACHE_SIZE_GB` cautiously; defaults are dynamically calculated and clamped by device type. |
| VLM/LLM fails on NPU | The VLM is not supported on NPU (one image per request; VSS sends several frames). An NPU LLM must be a text-only `-cw-` repo | Set `VLM_TARGET_DEVICE=CPU` or `GPU`. For the LLM use `OVMS_LLM_MODEL_NAME=OpenVINO/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct-int4-cw-ov`, or set `LLM_TARGET_DEVICE=CPU`. |
| vLLM mode fails | `vllm-cpu-service` cannot load `VLM_MODEL_NAME`, insufficient CPU KV cache, missing HF token, or context setting issue | Check `vllm-cpu-service` `/health` and logs; verify `HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN`, `VLLM_CPU_KVCACHE_SPACE`, `VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN`. |
| vLLM XPU logs show `No available memory for the cache blocks` | Model weights plus the vision encoder leave no room for the KV cache on a small GPU | Use an FP8 checkpoint and raise `VLLM_GPU_MEM`, lower `VLLM_MAX_MODEL_LEN` and `VLLM_MM_MAX_PIXELS` together; see `docs/user-guide/troubleshooting.md` for the sizing formula. |
| `vllm-xpu-service` starts but runs on CPU or cannot see the GPU | `/dev/dri` not passed through, or the container user is not in the render/video groups | Check `ls -ln /dev/dri` on the host and the `devices`/`group_add` entries in `docker/compose.vllm.xpu.yaml`; confirm `xpu-smi`/`clinfo` sees the card. |
| EVAM/DLStreamer ingestion stalled | `video-ingestion` unhealthy, RabbitMQ MQTT (`1883`) unavailable, MinIO unavailable, or object detection model download failed | Check `video-ingestion` `/pipelines`, RabbitMQ, MinIO, and `ov_models/object-detection/ultralytics/public/<model>/FP32` artifacts. |
| `audio-analyzer` unhealthy | Invalid `ASR_MODEL`/`ASR_DEVICE`, MinIO, or device access failure | Verify `ASR_MODEL`/`ASR_DEVICE`, MinIO credentials, and `/dev/dri` if GPU-related settings are used. |
| Search UI says no videos found | No processed videos, embeddings not generated, vector DB empty, or `video-search`/`multimodal-dataprep`/`vector-retriever`/embedding service unhealthy | Check `video-search`, `multimodal-dataprep`, `vector-retriever`, `vdms-vector-db` (or the Milvus stack when `VECTORDB_BACKEND=milvus`), `multimodal-embedding-serving`, and ingestion logs. |
| Video embedding fails with `Pipeline made no progress for <N>s` | A DataPrep detection or embedding inference never returned (usually a GPU hang); the stall watchdog failed the job after `MM_DATAPREP_PIPELINE_STALL_TIMEOUT_S` (default `300`) | Check `multimodal-dataprep` logs and `dmesg` for GPU hang/reset, restart the container, or move the stage to CPU (`DATAPREP_DETECTION_DEVICE=CPU` / `DATAPREP_EMBEDDING_DEVICE=CPU`); raise the timeout only for legitimately slow hardware. The video's `searchEmbeddings` becomes `false` unless it was already `true`; retry with `POST /manager/videos/search-embeddings/{videoId}`. |
| Search returns no results after changing embedding model | Existing vectors have dimensions from the old embedding model, or a metric/index mismatch between `multimodal-dataprep` and `vector-retriever` | Re-ingest videos with the active `MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL` or `TEXT_EMBEDDING_MODEL`; if needed run `source setup.sh --clean-data` then `source setup.sh --search`. Confirm `vector-retriever` flavor matches `VECTORDB_BACKEND`. |
| Poor search accuracy | Model dimensionality, frame sampling, object detection, or low video diversity | Review embedding model choice, `FRAME_INTERVAL`, `ENABLE_OBJECT_DETECTION`, and relevance scores. |
| Summary/video processing shows OpenCV/OpenGL/Mesa errors | Missing Mesa/OpenGL libraries on certain kernels | Install `libgl1-mesa-dri libgl1-mesa-dev`, remove `ov_models/` if needed, redeploy, and retest. |
| Setup exits before starting containers | Required environment variables missing | Set MinIO/Postgres/RabbitMQ credentials; for summary set `VLM_MODEL_NAME`, `ASR_MODEL`, `OD_MODEL_NAME`; for search set `MULTIMODAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL`; for unified set `TEXT_EMBEDDING_MODEL`; for search/dual set `DATAPREP_DETECTION_MODEL` (or `ENABLE_OBJECT_DETECTION=false`). |
| `multimodal-dataprep` exits at startup with `no detection model is configured` | `MM_DATAPREP_DETECTION_MODEL_NAME` is empty while object detection is enabled | Export `DATAPREP_DETECTION_MODEL` (a Hugging Face OpenVINO detection model, for example `OpenVINO/yolox_s-int8-ov`) and rerun setup, or set `ENABLE_OBJECT_DETECTION=false`. On Helm set `multimodaldataprep.frameProcessing.detectionModelName`. |
| `multimodal-dataprep` exits with `must be a Hugging Face model repo in the 'OpenVINO' namespace (OpenVINO/<repo>)` | `DATAPREP_DETECTION_MODEL` is an old GitHub YOLOX name (e.g. `yolox_s`) or a repo outside `OpenVINO/` | Use an `OpenVINO/<repo>` id from <https://huggingface.co/OpenVINO>, e.g. `OpenVINO/yolox_s-int8-ov`. |
| No object crops; dataprep `/v1/dataprep/health` shows `detection_status: "not_loaded"` | The Hugging Face model download failed (no network/proxy), the repo is not an object detection model, or detection failed to initialize on the selected device | Check `multimodal-dataprep` logs. Allow access to `huggingface.co` (proxy vars), or pre-populate the `docker_dataprep-detection-models` volume for offline hosts. For NPU, check per-model support on the [OpenVINO supported models](https://docs.openvino.ai/nightly/documentation/compatibility-and-support/supported-models.html) page or set `DATAPREP_DETECTION_DEVICE=CPU`. |
| Dataprep logs `MM_DATAPREP_DETECTION_CLASSES contains classes not provided by <model>: ... Available classes: ...` (health shows `detection_status: "not_loaded"`) | `DATAPREP_DETECTION_CLASSES` names a class the model does not have (labels use underscores, e.g. `traffic_light`) | Fix the class list using the names from the error, or unset `DATAPREP_DETECTION_CLASSES` to keep all classes. |
